name: Сундуки режимов по семи редкостям — листы 4 × 2 на 21:9 4K (design/ui/screens/chest-open.js, запасы, награды). Слово автора 30.09.2026: «сами лутбоксов тоже надо генерить не мало сетками от обычных до вневременных при это сами лутбоксы должны отличаться по виду от режима чтобы они были индивидуальными. Но при этом они у нас используются в анимации, нужно будет генерить их более крупными размерами чтобы качество картинки при анимации не терялось»

plan.Лист на режим: семь редкостей сундука режима и его навесной замок — сетка 4 × 2 на 21:9 4K (6336 × 2688), клетка 1584 × 1344, сундук — около 1200 px в ширину: вдвое крупнее, чем нужно окну открытия на телефоне. Весь лист — ровный пурпурный ключ: клетки без швов, каждый предмет — пятном альфы, порядок — по строкам (craft_layers.cut)
plan.Один сундук — лестница редкостей: вид, ракурс, пропорции и знак режима одни на все семь; редкость растёт материалом, оковкой, камнем и светом изнутри — язык снаряжения сеткой (art/style/style.md), цвета камней — ADR-0027
plan.Крышка: как у прежних сундуков (jobs/chests.json): сундук закрыт, прямой горизонтальный шов, через шов ничего не идёт; chest_layers.py sheets режет каждый сундук по шву на корпус и крышку — крышка откидывается в 3D, изнанка — та же крышка, тёмная и перевёрнутая. Шов ищется сам (тёмная полоса строк в средних 60 % ширины), поправка — seams в разделе layers
plan.Замок: восьмая клетка — навесной замок режима; прежний общий замок (jobs/chests.json) остаётся запасным

style: Dark fantasy mobile RPG game art with a gloomy, mystical atmosphere. Painterly digital illustration with soft transitions, elaborate shadows and confident visible brushwork; simplified large readable forms; a crisp rim light along the edges. Rich worn materials: dark forged iron, old gold, weathered wood, carved stone, aged leather. Precious, dramatic, high contrast. No photorealism, no 3D-render look, no anime.
negative: No text, no letters, no numbers, no runes, no glyphs, no real-world alphabets, no watermark, no signature, no logo, no UI elements, no captions or labels under or over the objects, no grid lines, no frames or borders around the cells or the picture. No pentagrams, no occult signs.

chest-sheet.frame:
Format: one sheet of eight separate game item paintings for a loot-chest opening animation, painted together as one consistent set on one flat, uniform, solid pure magenta (#FF00FF) background that fills the whole canvas edge to edge. The attached reference is this very chest as it was painted before (approved game art): match its brushwork, lighting and color handling, keep its straight front view, its form, its proportions and its sign in all seven chests — but do NOT copy its white outline. The sheet is divided into eight equal invisible cells — four columns and two rows. Each cell holds exactly one object, standing alone and centered in its cell, with a wide empty magenta margin all around it; nothing touches, overlaps or crosses into a neighbouring cell. There are no lines, gutters, frames, panels, pedestals or labels between or around the cells — the flat magenta background runs unbroken between the objects, with no dividing line anywhere. Reading order: the top row from left to right is cells 1 to 4, the bottom row from left to right is cells 5 to 8.

Cells 1 to 7 show the same treasure chest in seven rarities, from common in cell 1 to timeless in cell 7. It is one and the same chest growing in rarity: its kind, its view, its proportions, its basic silhouette and its sign stay the same, and it grows richer with every step — in material, in fittings, in gems and in the light inside it:
1. common — the plain, worn version: dark iron fittings, no ornament, no gems, no inner light.
2. rare — sound polished fittings of steel with brass rivets and a thin gold edging; one small yellow gem (#F0CC4F) glows faintly.
3. unique — fine blued steel fittings with thin silver inlay; one turquoise gem (#1FB8D0) glows softly.
4. epic — dark steel with gold filigree edging; a cool blue-violet crystal (#A986EE) glows from within — violet, never pink or magenta.
5. ancient — heavy ancient metal darkened by ages, with gold fittings; a red crystal (#E85A4E) with a swirl of flame inside it; thin red cracks glow in the metal.
6. primordial — black metal and old gold of a primordial make; bright orange fire (#EB9D40) burns inside its crystal and in thin cracks of the metal like molten metal — inside only, no flames rise above the chest.
7. timeless — the richest of all: dark metal and bright gold with ornate fittings; a large green crystal (#5FD67A) radiating light; green energy glows from within the ornament.
Cell 8 shows the padlock of this chest, described below.

Every chest: seen straight from the front, exactly like the attached reference — the camera a little above the chest (about 15 degrees), perfectly symmetric left to right, so we see the front face and only a thin sliver of the top; the side faces are hidden, never a three-quarter view. Every chest fills about three quarters of its cell's width. Construction: every chest is two separate pieces, a body and a lid resting on it. Where they meet, one clean, straight, perfectly horizontal seam runs across the whole front from the left edge of the chest to the right edge; a thin dark shadow line marks it. Nothing crosses the seam: no lock, no padlock, no hasp, no latch, no strap, no band, no hinge, no crystal and no decoration goes from the lid down onto the body or from the body up onto the lid — the lock is added separately by the game. The seam itself stays a thin dark line on every chest: no light, no fire and no glow in it. The middle of the seam is kept free for the game's padlock: no badge, no gem, no clasp, no plate and no ornament sits on the seam or across it; a gem or a badge sits in the middle of the lid front, well above the seam, or in the middle of the body front, well below it.

Lighting: soft pale neutral light from below and from the front, a crisp pale rim light along the whole silhouette. The chests do not glow as a whole: only their gems and thin cracks shine from within, and every light stays strictly inside the object's silhouette — every crystal and gem ends in a crisp, clean edge against the flat magenta: no halo, no aura, no glow, no bloom, no rays, no sparks, no flames, no mist and no light spill on the magenta around the object, not even around the brightest crystals; the game adds colored magic light around the chest itself. Rendering: a rich painterly dark-fantasy illustration with loose, confident brush strokes — deep shadows, textured stone and worn metal with real volume and depth. Edges are defined by rim light and shadow, never by a drawn line: no black contour line around the silhouette or its parts, no white outline, no sticker border, no cel-shading, no cartoon or casual mobile-game look. Large readable shapes that still read at 64 px; the painterly detail lives inside the silhouette, nothing floats around it: no sparks, no dust, no particles, no smoke. The background everywhere is the flat magenta: no gradient, no vignette, no texture, no floor, no ground line, no cast shadow, no reflection, no checkerboard transparency pattern. Do not use magenta or pink anywhere on the objects.

jobs.title: Сундук осколков — реликварий Эхо, семь редкостей и замок
jobs.source: lootboxes.js boxes.shards; §17, §23; прежний вид — jobs/chests.json chest-shards
jobs.subject:
This sheet: the reliquary of the Echo, a chest that keeps the soul shards of heroes of ancient civilizations. The chest: heavy smooth blocks of dark grey-black basalt bound with broad metal bands along the corners and across the body; a low stone slab lid, and along the top of the lid grows a crest of crystal shards — several crystal points of different heights, the sign of this chest. Cold, heavy, ancient. The crest carries the rarity: common — rough grey basalt with plain dark iron bands and a low crest of dull, clouded grey quartz; rare — the bands are polished steel with brass rivets, among the quartz points one small yellow citrine glows faintly; unique — smoother basalt with blued steel bands and thin silver inlay, the crest of clear turquoise crystals glowing softly; epic — basalt with gold filigree along the bands, the crest of blue-violet amethyst points glowing from within; ancient — ancient black stone with dark bronze and gold bands, the crest of red crystals with a swirl of flame inside, thin red cracks glow in the stone; primordial — black glassy stone and black metal with old gold, the crest of orange crystals with fire burning inside them like molten metal, no flames above them, orange fire in thin cracks of the stone; timeless — black stone with bright ornate gold bands, a tall crown of large green crystals radiating light, green energy in the ornament. The crest grows taller and fuller with the rarity but always stays on the lid.

Cell 8, the padlock of this chest: a heavy old padlock seen straight from the front, upright and perfectly symmetric — a thick rounded body of blackened iron with a tarnished silver rim, one small clouded quartz point set above a large dark empty keyhole, and a thick curved iron shackle on top. It fills about 55% of its cell's height and does not glow.

jobs.title: Сундук ключей — окованный ларь контрактов, семь редкостей и замок
jobs.source: lootboxes.js boxes.keys; §18, §23; прежний вид — jobs/chests.json chest-keys
jobs.subject:
This sheet: the keybearer's strongbox of the contracts, a chest that keeps rune keys. The chest: blackened forged iron plates riveted together, reinforced with thick metal bands and heavy corners; a flat lid; squat and heavy, a small fortress. Its sign: a row of three ornate keyhole plates on the front of the body, and two big old keys lying across the top of the lid as its hinges. The keys carry the rarity: common — rusty blackened iron, dull iron bands and keyhole plates, plain iron keys; rare — polished steel bands with brass rivets, brass keyhole plates and brass keys with a small yellow gem in the bow of each key; unique — blued steel with thin silver inlay, silver keyhole plates, silver keys with turquoise gems; epic — dark steel with gold filigree edging, gold keyhole plates, gold keys with blue-violet crystals; ancient — ancient dark bronze and gold, red crystals with a swirl of flame in the keys, thin red cracks glowing in the iron; primordial — black metal and old gold, orange crystals in the keys with fire burning inside them, orange fire in the three keyholes and in thin cracks of the iron; timeless — dark metal and bright ornate gold, large green crystals in the keys radiating light, green light in the keyholes and the ornament.

Cell 8, the padlock of this chest: a heavy old padlock seen straight from the front, upright and perfectly symmetric — blackened forged iron with heavy bronze rivets and a bronze rim, the heaviest padlock of all, a large dark empty keyhole in its center and a thick curved shackle on top. It fills about 55% of its cell's height and does not glow.

jobs.title: Сундук снаряжения — оружейный ящик Арены и Лиги, семь редкостей и замок
jobs.source: lootboxes.js boxes.equip; §20, §21, §23; прежний вид — jobs/chests.json chest-equip
jobs.subject:
This sheet: the arena armory crate, a chest that keeps weapons and armor. The chest: long dark oak planks bound with dented metal corner plates and metal bands; longer and lower than a common chest, like a weapon case, with a flat lid; battered, scratched, practical. Its sign: a round shield with a sword crossed behind it, mounted in the middle of the lid front, well above the seam. The shield carries the rarity: common — rough dark oak, plain iron bands, a plain round iron shield and a plain sword; rare — steel bands with brass rivets, the shield with a brass rim and a small yellow gem boss; unique — blued steel with thin silver inlay, the shield edged in silver with a turquoise gem boss; epic — gold filigree along the bands, the shield with gold filigree and a blue-violet crystal boss; ancient — ancient dark bronze and gold, a red crystal boss with a swirl of flame inside, thin red cracks glowing in the old wood; primordial — charred black oak and black metal with old gold, orange fire burning in the shield's crystal and in thin cracks of the wood like embers; timeless — dark wood and bright ornate gold, a large green crystal in the shield radiating light, green energy along the ornament.

Cell 8, the padlock of this chest: a heavy old padlock seen straight from the front, upright and perfectly symmetric — a sturdy steel padlock with dents and scratches and a riveted steel rim, a large dark empty keyhole in its center and a thick curved shackle on top. It fills about 55% of its cell's height and does not glow.

jobs.title: Сундук талисманов — шкатулка духа кланового босса, семь редкостей и замок
jobs.source: lootboxes.js boxes.talisman; §25, §26, §23; прежний вид — jobs/chests.json chest-talisman
jobs.subject:
This sheet: the spirit casket, a jewel casket that keeps spirit talismans. The casket: lacquered wood, corner caps and four small claw feet, a high rounded domed lid; refined and precious, taller and narrower than a common chest. Its sign: a large oval moonstone set in the middle of the lid front, well above the seam. The moonstone carries the rarity: common — dark stained wood, plain iron corner caps and feet, a small dull milky-grey moonstone in an iron mount; rare — brass fittings and feet, the moonstone with a faint warm yellow gleam inside; unique — glossy black lacquer with silver fittings, the moonstone glowing softly turquoise inside; epic — black lacquer with fine gold filigree, the moonstone with a blue-violet light inside; ancient — ancient dark gold, the moonstone with a red swirl of flame inside, thin red cracks glowing in the lacquer; primordial — black lacquer and old gold, orange fire inside the moonstone and in thin cracks of the lacquer; timeless — bright ornate gold filigree over black lacquer, a large moonstone radiating green light, green energy along the filigree.

Cell 8, the padlock of this chest: a heavy old padlock seen straight from the front, upright and perfectly symmetric — an elegant padlock of black lacquered metal with fine old-gold filigree and a small milky moonstone above the keyhole, a large dark empty keyhole in its center and a thick curved shackle on top. It fills about 55% of its cell's height and does not glow.

jobs.title: Сундук рабочих — рабочий короб События, семь редкостей и замок
jobs.source: lootboxes.js boxes.workers; §19, §27, §23; прежний вид — jobs/chests.json chest-workers
jobs.subject:
This sheet: the workers' crate of the Event, a chest that keeps the shards of hired workers. The crate: light pale sanded wood planks with rough metal fittings, thick coiled rope handles on both sides of the body, a flat lid with a small wrench fixed across it; honest and sturdy, a craftsman's box, the corners worn smooth by hands. Its sign: two big cogwheels mounted on the front of the body, one left and one right of the middle. The cogwheels carry the rarity: common — pale rough planks, rusty iron fittings, iron cogwheels, hemp rope; rare — steel fittings with brass rivets, brass cogwheels with a small yellow gem at each hub; unique — blued steel fittings with silver inlay, silver cogwheels with turquoise gems at their hubs; epic — dark steel with gold filigree edging, gold cogwheels with blue-violet crystal hubs; ancient — dark aged wood and ancient bronze with gold, red crystal hubs with a swirl of flame, thin red cracks glowing in the wood; primordial — charred black wood and black metal with old gold, orange fire inside the hubs and in thin cracks of the wood like embers; timeless — dark wood and bright ornate gold, green crystal hubs radiating light, green energy along the ornament.

Cell 8, the padlock of this chest: a heavy old padlock seen straight from the front, upright and perfectly symmetric — a plain workman's padlock of dark iron with a brass plate shaped like a cogwheel around the keyhole, a large dark empty keyhole in its center and a thick curved shackle on top. It fills about 55% of its cell's height and does not glow.

jobs.title: Сундук крафтового босса — каменный сундук руин, семь редкостей и замок
jobs.source: lootboxes.js boxes.craft; §12.3, §23; прежний вид — jobs/chests.json chest-craft
jobs.subject:
This sheet: the ruin chest of a craft boss, carved from one block of weathered stone taken from ancient ruins. The chest: rough stone with deep chips and cracks, metal clamps at the corners; the lid is a thick heavy stone slab; massive, old and dusty. Its sign: a plain crown shape carved in relief in the middle of the lid front, well above the seam. The crown carries the rarity: common — weathered light-grey stone with patches of dark green moss, corroded green-bronze clamps, a plain carved crown; rare — cleaner grey stone, steel clamps with brass rivets, the crown with a small yellow gem; unique — smooth blue-grey stone, blued steel clamps with silver inlay, the crown inlaid with silver and a turquoise gem; epic — dark stone with gold filigree inlaid along the edges and the crown, a blue-violet crystal in the crown; ancient — ancient dark stone with bronze and gold clamps, a red crystal with a swirl of flame in the crown, thin red cracks glowing in the stone; primordial — black volcanic stone and black metal with old gold, orange fire in the crown's crystal and in thin cracks of the stone like lava; timeless — dark stone and bright ornate gold, a large green crystal in the crown radiating light, green energy in the carved ornament.

Cell 8, the padlock of this chest: a heavy old padlock seen straight from the front, upright and perfectly symmetric — a heavy padlock of corroded green bronze with a chipped stone face, a large dark empty keyhole in its center and a thick curved shackle on top. It fills about 55% of its cell's height and does not glow.

jobs.title: Сундук странника — дорожный сундук, семь редкостей и замок
jobs.source: lootboxes.js boxes.wander; §2, §23, §29; прежний вид — jobs/chests.json chest-wander
jobs.subject:
This sheet: the wanderer's travel trunk, carried along long roads. The trunk: leather over a wooden frame, metal corner caps and rows of studs, a rounded domed lid; two leather straps with buckles run over the lid only and end above the seam; weathered by roads, patched, well loved. Its sign: a round plate with a plain solid four-pointed star embossed on it in the middle of the lid, well above the seam. The star plate carries the rarity: common — worn patched brown leather, plain iron studs and corner caps, an iron star plate; rare — oiled brown leather with brass studs and corners, a brass star plate with a small yellow gem in the center; unique — dark blue-dyed leather with silver fittings, a silver star plate with a turquoise gem; epic — deep brown leather tooled with gold filigree, a gold star plate with a blue-violet crystal; ancient — ancient dark leather with bronze and gold fittings, a red crystal with a swirl of flame in the star, thin red cracks glowing in the leather; primordial — black leather and black metal with old gold, orange fire in the star's crystal and in thin cracks like embers; timeless — dark leather and bright ornate gold, a large green crystal in the star radiating light, green energy in the tooled ornament.

Cell 8, the padlock of this chest: a heavy old padlock seen straight from the front, upright and perfectly symmetric — a travel padlock of brass and dark leather-wrapped iron with a small plain four-pointed star above the keyhole, a large dark empty keyhole in its center and a thick curved shackle on top. It fills about 55% of its cell's height and does not glow.
